crossRefs.note: He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of…

translations.web: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
translations.bsb: The miner strikes the flint; he overturns mountains at their base.
translations.kjv: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
translations.asv: He putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.
